name: TIIF Bench
intro: TIIF-Bench用5000条短/长语义等价提示系统评测文本到图像指令跟随，覆盖基础、进阶与设计师三级，并加入文本渲染、风格控制和100条真实设计师提示。全量提示对应12074个细粒度二元问题，另提供554提示/1446问题的TestMini。
org: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Tsinghua University, OPPO Research Institute
build_method: 10个概念池、36种属性组合、GPT-4o提示构造、短长扩写、人工设计师提示与参考图核验
metric: TIIF二元检查得分、GNED文本渲染、CSD+DINOv3风格相似度
task_type: 图像生成, 指令跟随
eval_feature: 短长提示鲁棒性, 属性级二元检查, 文本与风格专用指标
scale: 5000条提示、12074个二元问题；TestMini含554条提示与1446个问题
build_method_en: Ten concept pools, 36 attribute combinations, GPT-4o prompt composition, short/long expansion, manually curated designer prompts, and verified reference images
eval_feature_en: Short/long prompt robustness, attribute-level binary checklists, dedicated text and style metrics
intro_en: TIIF-Bench uses 5,000 semantically equivalent short/long prompt pairs to evaluate text-to-image instruction following at Basic, Advanced, and Designer levels. It adds text rendering, style control, and 100 real-world designer prompts. The full set has 12,074 fine-grained binary questions, with a 554-prompt/1,446-question TestMini subset.
scale_en: 5,000 prompts and 12,074 binary questions; TestMini has 554 prompts and 1,446 questions
metric_en: TIIF binary-check score, GNED text rendering, and CSD + DINOv3 style similarity

drawio_review_note: Aligned with TIIF-Bench arXiv:2506.02161v3 Section 3 and Appendices A1-A3; official TIIF_Bench project page and released data. TIIF-Bench constructs ten dimension-specific concept pools by grouping prompts from existing benchmarks and asking GPT-4o to extract object, attribute, and relation pairs. Thirty-six combination policies create Basic within-group and Advanced cross-group compositions, which GPT-4o turns into natural instructions. Text-rendering prompts come from Lex-Art, style-control prompts come from AIGC communities and receive manually verified reference images at five aspect ratios, and humans curate 100 real-world Designer-Level prompts. Every prompt is expanded into a longer paraphrase with identical semantics. The full benchmark has 5,000 prompts and 12,074 binary checklist questions; the balanced TestMini subset has 554 prompts and 1,446 questions. During evaluation a T2I model generates an image, TIIF-Evaluator answers attribute-specific yes/no questions, and checklist accuracy gives fine-grained instruction following. Text rendering uses OCR plus Global Normalized Edit Distance with Hungarian matching and unmatched-word penalties. Style control compares the nearest-aspect-ratio reference using CSD and DINOv3 similarity. Scores are reported by Basic, Advanced, Designer level and short-versus-long robustness.
